concerns.location: tasks.md:T006, T008 vs spec.md:FR-005, US-3 Scenario 1
concerns.text: FR-005 and US-3 mandate exactly 10,000 permutation shuffles; T006 ('reduce to 1,000 only if the 6-hour budget is genuinely exceeded') and T008 ('fallback 1,000 with logged justification') silently weaken a stated MUST. No spec amendment or plan fallback authorizes this reduction — plan.md's fallbacks cover SC targets, not shuffle counts.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T001–T012 vs constitution.md:Reproducibility Requirements / Principle VII
concerns.text: Constitution requires a pinned requirements.txt (or pyproject.toml) at code/ and Principle VII requires pinned package versions; no task creates or maintains a dependency manifest. T001 sets up config.py but not the requirements file, so the reproducibility gate has no implementing task.

T005 requires one parquet to conform to BOTH schemas, but they have mutually exclusive required fields (output.schema requires grid_cell/model_id/term/fdr_q_value/r_squared; gamm_results.schema requires climate_variable/convergence_status/gp_included with additionalProperties:false). The task as written is unverifiable; designate one schema or reconcile.

Spec requires Moran's I > 0.15 to 'trigger a re-fit with a Gaussian Process (GP) random effect using a Matérn covariance function'. T005 makes the GP mandatory a priori and T006 makes Moran's I a post-hoc flag only — the conditional re-fit behavior in the spec's acceptance scenario has no implementing task, so the scenario cannot be demonstrated as written.

FR-001 mandates NOAA/PRISM climate data and the North American EBD 2020–2024; FR-002 names the Cornell Lab of Ornithology list. T001/T002 substitute Daymet, a sampled eBird dataset, and accept 'a pinned raw GitHub URL of a public migratory-species list'. T001 documents the data-source deviation in an amendments file, but the spec itself was never amended and the Cornell-list broadening is undocumented — a standing contradiction between ratified requirements and task scope.

US-1 Scenario 1 requires verification of 'a minimum of 208 weeks of data per grid cell' and phenology metrics for a minimum percentage of species-year combinations. T003's verification only checks parquet columns and unit tests; no task measures or asserts weekly coverage or species-year metric coverage, dropping the acceptance criterion.

plan.md specifies a src/-rooted layout (src/config.py, src/data/download.py) while every task builds under code/. The deviation is noted in prose but no artifact records it; add a structural-deviation note (like the data-sources amendment) so an implementer following plan.md does not produce files no task verifies.

Principle VI requires archived raw-data metadata including 'sensor version' (dataset version). T002's data_availability_report.json specifies streaming rule, split, chunk size, and row counts only; extend it to record dataset/sensor version metadata for the archived eBird and Daymet files.
